description: Use for a DEX swap quote with a ready unsigned transaction: best route from Velora (ParaSwap), KyberSwap as fallback, on Base, Arbitrum, Ethereum, Optimism, Polygon, BNB Chain. Returns the paid x402 request for your input (GET /quote/swap, $0.002 per call; schema linked). Call that URL with an x402 or MPP client to get the data. Bad input is refused before any charge. Quote only: nothing is signed or sent, and the reply discloses P0's integrator fee. To check balances first use wallet_balance. With an access key (Authorization: Bearer p0k_..., buy at https://x402-bazaar-rank.x402-bazaar-rank-worker.workers.dev/keys/buy?usd=5) the tool pays the call itself, returns the data and deducts the price. First call each day returns the data itself, free; later calls return the paid request.

amount.description: Integer string, amount to sell in base units (10 USDC = 10000000)

chain.description: base, arbitrum, ethereum, optimism, polygon or bsc (or chain id)

from.description: token to sell: symbol (USDC, WETH, ETH...) or 0x address

from_decimals.description: Decimals of the sell token; needed only when it is an address P0 does not know

slippage_bps.description: max slippage in basis points (50 = 0.5%). The alias 'slippage' is read as basis points too (Velora's unit); a 'slippage' below 10 is refused as ambiguous

taker.description: Wallet that will sign and send; the returned calldata and approval are built for it

to.description: token to buy: symbol or 0x address

to_decimals.description: Decimals of the buy token; needed only when it is an address P0 does not know

name: quote_swap
title: Quote swap
